record.name: Politico
record.description: Politicos are masters of social manipulation and leadership, using their charisma and political acumen to influence others and shape the course of events.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: A master of politics and diplomacy, a Politico excels at influencing others to achieve their goals.

progression_tree.description: Gain a boost to your Charisma score, reflecting your growing reputation as a skilled politician.

effects.notes: The politico's presence bursts forth, radiating charisma and commanding attention. In the heat of battle, they gain a burst of persuasive power, amplifying their charm and magnetism.

progression_tree.description: Develop your skills in negotiation and persuasion, allowing you to extract more concessions from others.

effects.notes: With calculated ease, the colonist's Politico subclass activates their linguistic acumen, granting them proficiency in two languages of choice. As a native linguist, they effortlessly navigate even the most complex dialects.

progression_tree.description: Learn a new technique for using your charisma to influence others, such as a persuasive speech or a clever quip.

effects.notes: As the Politico uses an action, their words gain resonance with the crowd. They can choose to apply their Charisma bonus to a single skill check or ability check they make within the same turn.

progression_tree.description: Demonstrate your mastery of politics by taking a leadership role in your community.

effects.notes: The Politico's charisma is palpable, granting nearby allies a +1 bonus to their leadership ability.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Assumes the stance of a seasoned politician, ready to negotiate or persuade with an air of confidence and authority.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: Surrounded by an aura of subtle yet palpable influence, as if their words have a tangible effect on those around them.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Generate a portrait of a skilled Politico standing confidently in a dimly lit room, surrounded by holographic projections and data streams.
